steps.question: The miser came to the hole to see his ...

questionMeaning.hi: कंजूस गड्ढे पर क्या देखने आता था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kanjoos gaddhe par kya dekhne aata tha?

steps.question: The neighbours who came running did not know ...

questionMeaning.hi: पड़ोसियों को क्या नहीं पता था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Padosiyon ko kya nahi pata tha?

steps.question: What was the only pleasure of the miser?

questionMeaning.hi: कंजूस की इकलौती ख़ुशी क्या थी?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kanjoos ki iklauti khushi kya thi?

options: to come every day and see his treasure
steps.answer: to come every day and see his treasure
steps.modelAnswer: The only pleasure of the miser was to come every day to see his treasure in the hole.

modelMeaning.hi: कंजूस की इकलौती ख़ुशी थी रोज़ आकर गड्ढे में अपना ख़ज़ाना देखना।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kanjoos ki iklauti khushi thi roz aakar gaddhe mein apna khazaana dekhna.

steps.question: What did the robber do with the gold?

questionMeaning.hi: चोर ने सोने का क्या किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Chor ne sone ka kya kiya?

options: He came back the same night and took it away.
He gave it to the king.
He put more gold in it.
steps.answer: He came back the same night and took it away.
steps.modelAnswer: The robber came back the very same night and took away the gold.

modelMeaning.hi: चोर उसी रात वापस आया और सोना ले गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Chor usi raat waapas aaya aur sona le gaya.

steps.question: Why did the miser make a terrible clatter?

questionMeaning.hi: कंजूस ने इतना शोर क्यों मचाया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kanjoos ne itna shor kyon machaaya?

steps.modelAnswer: The miser made a terrible clatter because he found that his treasure was gone.

modelMeaning.hi: कंजूस ने बहुत शोर मचाया क्योंकि उसका ख़ज़ाना गायब था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kanjoos ne bahut shor machaaya kyonki uska khazaana gaayab tha.

steps.question: What did the neighbours ask the miser?

questionMeaning.hi: पड़ोसियों ने कंजूस से क्या पूछा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Padosiyon ne kanjoos se kya poochha?

options: What did you do with the gold before it was gone?
steps.answer: What did you do with the gold before it was gone?
steps.modelAnswer: The neighbours asked him what he did with the gold before it was gone.

modelMeaning.hi: पड़ोसियों ने पूछा कि सोना जाने से पहले तुम उसका क्या करते थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Padosiyon ne poochha ki sona jaane se pehle tum uska kya karte the.

steps.question: What did the miser say in reply?
options: He came every day to see it.
He gave it to the poor.
steps.answer: He came every day to see it.
steps.modelAnswer: The miser replied that he came every day to see it, and now he did not know what to do.

modelMeaning.hi: कंजूस ने कहा कि वह रोज़ उसे देखने आता था, और अब क्या करे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kanjoos ne kaha ki woh roz use dekhne aata tha, aur ab kya kare.

steps.question: Why did the friend say ‘look at the hole instead’?

questionMeaning.hi: दोस्त ने ‘गड्ढा देखते रहो’ क्यों कहा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dost ne ‘gaddha dekhte raho’ kyon kaha?

options: The gold was of no use to the miser anyway.
The robber would bring the gold back.
steps.answer: The gold was of no use to the miser anyway.
